title: sbert roadmap
text: O(k) centroid initializer — rewrote farthest-point seeding O(k^2) O(k); fixes large-corpus memory blowup crashed session, ~24x faster init, bit-identical selections topic_corpus() — embed tokenize corpus , reuse across many models; select_topics() shares internally longer re-tokenizes per candidate (including inside coherence()) cores argument — parallel tokenization, segmentation, sweep candidates topics(), select_topics(), topic_corpus(), coherence(), segment(), topic_gamma(); byte-identical count strsplit tokenizer — single-pass base-R tokenization, ~1.5x faster, byte-identical, new dependency topic_gamma(dedupe_segments = ) — encode distinct segments (opt-; ~2x less encoding repetitive corpora) numbers = "keep"/"remove" — drop digit-tokens (years, counts) topic terms topics(), select_topics(), topic_corpus(), terms(); recorded settings coherence() stays consistent roman_numerals + section_numbers token filters — drop Roman-numeral chapter/list markers (bounded 100 ml/mm/cc survive) multi-level section indices (1.2.3); verbs, recorded settings Custom stop words documented — stop_words(add = ) plus bare vector character() topic verb; examples added segment(max_tokens = , model = ) — cap segment length nothing overruns encoder window; re-splits finest punctuation first, word-chops fallback; counts words offline exact model tokens topic_gamma() dual input — accepts raw documents segment() data frame, segmentation options live one place supplied embeddings always align; identical gamma segmentation matches covid dataset + articles — COVID-19 abstracts; topic-modeling article parallel/high-throughput article

title: sbert roadmap
text: keywords() — embedding-ranked keyword/phrase extraction MMR diversification (KeyBERT design) stop_words(add = , remove = ) — corpus-vocabulary exclusion select_topics() — coherence/diversity/separation sweep candidate topic counts topic_hierarchy() + reduce_topics() — topic dendrogram (cosine, deterministic) tree-cut merging fewer topics blend() — context-blended segment embeddings (residual alpha-blend) representatives() — margin-ranked evidence selection Static embeddings (Model2Vec) — potion-base-8M pinned; token lookup + mean base R, ~10k sentences/s, parity 3.3e-08 vs Python Seeded / guided topics — topics(seeds = , fixed_seeds = ); seed-initialized frozen centroids, seed-named labels

title: sbert roadmap
text: Dynamic topics — prevalence per-period c-TF-IDF time variable, holding assignments fixed. Natural fit temporal research line. Outlier awareness — k-means forces every document topic; add distance-threshold outlier class (deterministic alternative HDBSCAN noise). MMR term diversification + bigrams topic terms — reuse mmr_select() term embeddings; extend topic_term_scores() n-grams. Embedding-based coherence — mean pairwise term-embedding similarity third coherence() measure. Topic stability — label-invariant agreement (ARI) across perturbed refits (bootstrap resampling documents). Multilingual stop words — stop_words(language = ) currently wires "en"; hook exists. Build vetted lists (e.g. Snowball via tm build time, runtime dep) users’ non-English corpora. Deferred: every bundled modeled corpus English, shipped example needs yet.

title: sbert roadmap
text: static models — potion-base-32M (higher quality) potion-multilingual-128M (101 languages) demand shows; loader already supports . Matryoshka truncation — dimensions = encode() (truncate + renormalize); nomic-embed-text-v1.5 MRL-trained. Late chunking — successor blend(): pool unit token spans contextualized document pass. Requires exact char--token offset alignment, special-token exclusion, truncation-safe windowing (splice single truncated pass). Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B — current top open model; needs last-token pooling mode. EmbeddingGemma stays excluded gated.

Markets price shares."), 2,   segment = "sentence",   embeddings = rbind(c(1, 0), c(0, 1), c(0.9, 0.1), c(0.1, 0.9)) ) topic_gamma(sentence_model) #>   document_id topic gamma n_segments #> 1           1     1   0.5          2 #> 2           1     2   0.5          2 #> 3           2     1   0.5          2 #> 4           2     2   0.5          2 topic_gamma(sentence_model, top = 1) #>   document_id rank topic gamma n_segments #> 1           1    1     1   0.5          2 #> 2           2    1     1   0.5          2

title: sbert 0.3.0
text: Added feedback_translations dataset: 8,757 multilingual AI-generated mathematics feedback messages Levebee educational application paired English translations (8,005 distinct translations, template repetition preserved), giving every example vignette realistic offline corpus embedding, segmentation, topic-modeling workflow. Added sbert_segment(), deterministic rule-based text segmentation sentence, clause (default), phrase granularity. Sentence boundaries guarded word-boundary-anchored, case-insensitive abbreviation gazetteer (sbert_abbreviations()), decimal-number guard, parenthetical guard; clause level adds splits semicolons, colons, spaced dashes, subordinating hinges keeping comma enumerations whole. Returns tidy one-row-per-segment data frame preserves letter case. Promoted benchmarked analysis module (F1 0.999 realistic abbreviation-rich abstracts versus 0.80-0.82 ICU NLTK Punkt references).

title: sbert 0.2.0
text: Fixed topic tokenization normalize curly apostrophe (U+2019) straight apostrophe, contractions ’s one token. Added optional Porter stemming sbert_topics() (stem = TRUE, using SnowballC) collapses inflected forms displaying frequent surface form stem, giving cleaner, deduplicated topic terms. Made NPMI coherence exact co-occurrence limits (terms always never co-occur now score 1 -1 instead non-finite value). Added intrinsic topic-model evaluation: sbert_coherence() (UMass NPMI) sbert_diversity(), summary() method reports cluster separation, coherence, diversity alongside tidy per-topic table. Added deterministic base-graphics visualizations via plot() method topic models (type = "sizes", "terms", "map") sbert_palette() color helper. document map uses classical MDS cosine distance. Added weighting = "bm25" reduce_frequent_words options sbert_topics(), implementing BM25 square-root class-based TF-IDF variants Mendonca Figueira (2025). Fixed class-based TF-IDF average topic length real-valued rather integer-truncated, matching published formula (Eq. 1).

title: sbert 0.1.0
text: Added Python-free -MiniLM-L6-v2 inference tok onnxr. Added revision-pinned, SHA-256-verified model download cache management. Added mask-aware mean pooling, L2 normalization, cosine similarity. Added deterministic semantic topic modeling representative documents, Unicode tokenization, BERTopic-style class TF-IDF term summaries. Added offline unit tests optional official-model numerical parity tests.
